note: Tag in its default context Order is false | false, true | (none) | true, so createIf gives SUPPRESS | SUPPRESS, "" | (empty) | "". exists gives true per slot, SUPPRESS included, and false for the empty context: true | true, true | false | true, and removeContexts puts them under the root's one slot.
